limitations: One ordered local pair, baseline first. OS/filesystem warmth, CPU load and available RAM were uncontrolled; no causal or median estimate.
Both arms use the same frozen private input/runtime/date and unchanged39 original tests/current-stage logic, with identical per-case deepcopy isolation.

Metric is sum of sequential complete child wall times, including fresh fixture creation, typed decode, deepcopies, tests, guards, startup and child teardown. Common copy/preflight and small parent coordinator overhead are outside this metric.

The successful typed fixture-only change is the intentional optimization. Baseline driver and baseline execution projection/dependencies remain unchanged; baseline/optimized code lineage is recorded explicitly.

Fresh history is reconstructed once for optimized workers, not anew in each worker. No current test result or authority/approval is cached. Numeric-string coercion/heuristic repair and pickle are not used.

This is two representative modules under sequential local execution, not56module Foundation or four-worker ARM CI. Parallel CI critical-path benefit is unmeasured; do not change CI scheduler or skip required checks on this evidence.
No token, billing, provider, whole-task or production-performance saving is claimed. Failed development work is retained separately.
Any shared Foundation integration requires complete tools/efficiency validation including PHP-isolation/timeout fixtures and all mandatory acceptance.
portable_entry_scope: Same fresh-builder/FRESH_BASE/current-stage/case-isolation semantics; CLI/pinning/containment packaging validated separately without another expensive original-history run.
